text:
My setup:
1. airflow instead of Prefect. My airflow is running on a Docker inside an EC2. I will in future weeks explore a better solution possibly ECS.
2. airflow script calls 3 Lambda functions:
	Download(get file from github and save in raw/ folder)
	Unzip(unzip the file and save in unzip/ folder)
	LoadToRedshift(Load the unzipped file into redshift using COPY statement, and print load counts.
3. I only have 1 set of scripts for both green and yellow trip data files. I pass on the parameters from AWS secrets manager.

Todo:
1. Only pass database credentials from secret manager and rest configurations can come from parameter store
2. Setup airflow on ecs maybe(My airflow gets really slow on EC2),maybe try a bigger ec2, might even try prefect.
3. Include Email/slack functionality(not yet done).
4. I was facing access issue running COPY from redshift. So, I had to go into UI and grant elevated privilesgs. Will debug and adjust my TF file.
5. Explore AWS Code Commit, Code Build, deploy to see how I can build Lambdas from GIT directly.
6a. Setup the same lambdas using Docker.
6b. Setup the Dockers using AWS Batch.
6c. test out deployment using GIT
